REASONS.PERMISSAO_OS: {detail} is not allowed to create work orders in Mais Prático (work order access, Inclusão).
REASONS.PERMISSAO_CONVERSAO: {detail} does not have the "Conversão OS" permission in Mais Prático's quote access.
REASONS.CLIENTE: Customer {detail} does not exist in this ERP unit.
REASONS.CLIENTE_INATIVO: Customer {detail} is inactive in the ERP.
REASONS.MAQUINA: Machine {detail} does not exist in this ERP unit.
REASONS.MAQUINA_OBRIGATORIA: Pick the machine: this unit requires a machine on work orders.
REASONS.SEM_ITENS: Add at least one part or service.
REASONS.PRODUTO_INEXISTENTE: Product that does not exist in this unit: {detail}.
REASONS.PRODUTO_BLOQUEADO: Product blocked for sale in the ERP: {detail}.
REASONS.ORCAMENTO: Quote {detail} was not found in this unit.
REASONS.ORCAMENTO_STATUS: The quote is not in NEGOCIAÇÃO (it is {detail}).
REASONS.ORCAMENTO_COM_OS: The quote already became work order {detail}.
REASONS.ORCAMENTO_COM_PEDIDO: The quote already became sales order {detail}.
REASONS.ORCAMENTO_EM_USO: {detail} has this quote open in Mais Prático. Ask them to close it and try again.
REASONS.ORCAMENTO_SEM_ITENS: The quote has no parts or services.
REASONS.ORCAMENTO_NAO_FECHADO: The work order went in, but the quote could not be closed (someone opened it in Mais Prático). Try again: it continues the same work order.
REASONS.UNIDADE: This unit is not enabled for work orders from the chat (ERP settings).
REASONS.TIPO_ATENDIMENTO: Pick the service type (one of the ERP types).
REASONS.CABECALHO_RECUSADO: The ERP refused the work order (another one took the same number 3 times in a row). Try again in a moment.
REASONS.CABECALHO_NAO_GRAVADO: The ERP did not confirm the work order. Try again: if it went in, the chat finds it and continues.
REASONS.EM_ANDAMENTO: Another work order is being saved in this unit right now. Try again in a few seconds.
REASONS.ORDER_WRITE_DISABLED: Work orders from the chat are turned off in the ERP settings.
REASONS.ORDER_FORBIDDEN: Your access profile does not allow this, or the feature is off in the ERP settings.
REASONS.ERRO_INTERNO: Unexpected error in Chatwoot. Try again; if it repeats, tell the administrator.
REASONS.NOT_DRAFT: This work order is no longer a draft.
REASONS.IN_ERP: This work order already has an ERP number: you can only try again (same work order) or cancel it.
REASONS.COMPANY: Unit not enabled for work orders from the chat.
REASONS.TOO_MANY_ITEMS: At most 100 parts and services per work order.
REASONS.ITEM: Quantity and price must be positive numbers.
REASONS.NOT_CREATED: The work order is not in the ERP yet.
REASONS.CANCELLED: This work order was already cancelled.
REASONS.OS_MUDOU: The work order in the ERP is no longer the one the chat saved. Nothing was changed.
REASONS.OS_STATUS: The work order already left NEGOCIAÇÃO in Mais Prático: cancel it there.
